text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis.

The combination of progressive weakness, fatigue, and specifically mild diplopia (double vision) is highly suggestive of Myasthenia Gravis. I will need to order specific antibodies to confirm this. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine Receptor Antibodies and Anti-MuSK Antibodies.
